description:
Did a change help? Medians of cached share, prefill time, generation speed and prompt size for the turns before and after a moment, with the difference and a one-line verdict on the cache.
Use it after you changed a system prompt, keep_alive, num_ctx or the tool list. For the finding that prompted the change use diagnose_my_turns; for the raw sequence use list_my_turns.
split_minutes_ago: 1 to 10080, default 60: turns older than that are "before", newer are "after"; set it to the minutes since your change. client: your X-LLMxRay-Client name, so another tool's turns do not mix in. Both sides need at least one turn, else it says what to move.
Needs LLMxRay running (npx llmxray). Under a second. No model is called.

client.description: Substring of the client label, case-insensitive. Omit for all clients.

split_minutes_ago.description: Minutes ago that separate before from after, 1 to 10080. Default 60.

name: compare_my_turns
title: Compare my turns
